title: Which of the seven LCFs carries net1's cost to the learned net2: one LCF at a time from the truth, on validation
description: Each learned DAgger net2 on net1 v7 (round 29, iteration 39, training seeds 1 to 3; model-truth-patch-src) runs as trained (net2-v7-sN) and with some of expliCCit's seven LCFs taken from the guest's live truth instead of net1, nothing retrained (experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py --truth): capacity alone (net2-v7-cap-sN), one-way delay alone (net2-v7-owd-sN), both, which fixes the window's target at the true BDP (net2-v7-bdp-sN), and the other five (net2-v7-rest-sN). Question, stated before the run: exp-truth-patch-val-282 found that all seven from the truth gain 0.027 on the five-family mean and collapse among copies; which LCFs carry each? Expected: the BDP pair carries nearly all of both, capacity most of the collapse, since the window is u plus log2 of the believed BDP and u moves little (exp-occlusion-twins-val-276). The LCFs that carry the gain are where a repair of net1 alone (H5) should aim. Validation links at campaign seed 21 (the five families) and 2 and 4 copies, as in exp-truth-patch-val-282, whose records for net2-v7-sN this run repeats. Nothing is chosen; validation links only.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); P=(); declare -A T=([cap]="capacity_bps" [owd]="one_way_delay_ns" [bdp]="capacity_bps one_way_delay_ns" [rest]="queue_delay_mean_ns queue_pkts free_buffer_pkts busy_fraction receive_rate_bps"); for s in s1 s2 s3; do d="$OUT/runs/r29-$s"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-$s.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-$s.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-$s" "$d" --t 0.5; P+=(--policy "net2-v7-$s=$OUT/p/net2-v7-$s.onnx"); for k in cap owd bdp rest; do read -r -a L <<< "${T[$k]}"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-$k-$s" "$d" --t 0.5 --truth "${L[@]}"; P+=(--policy "net2-v7-$k-$s=$OUT/p/net2-v7-$k-$s.onnx"); done; done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 30 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s && for s in s1 s2 s3; do uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" "net2-v7-$s"; done
